target_definition: is_clean = 1 when s5cq22a is gas, briquette, biogas, electricity, or oil/kerosene

feature_sources.is_grid_connected: CS_S01_S5_S7_Household.dta s5cq14 in (1, 3): connected to the electricity grid
feature_sources.consumption_quintile: CS_S01_S5_S7_Household.dta quintile: real consumption per adult equivalent, 1 (lowest) to 5
feature_sources.minutes_to_food_market: CS_S5F_access_to_services.dta s5fq0 == 2 (food market / shop), s5fq3a * 60 + s5fq3b; missing filled with the sample median

methodology: Predicts observed EICV7 primary cooking fuel; it does not predict subsidy response.
subsidy_scenario: The subsidy slider uses a separate disclosed shift rule and is not an output of this classifier.
citations: NISR EICV7 (2024) Household Survey Microdata, CS_S01_S5_S7_Household.dta: s5cq22a, ur, pov_jan, epov_jan, s5cq14, quintile
NISR EICV7 (2024) Household Survey Microdata, CS_S5F_access_to_services.dta: s5fq0, s5fq3a, s5fq3b
